video_title: LeBron said OG Anunoby was the Knicks' MVP in the NBA Finals 👀 | Get Up YouTube Exclusive

quotes.speaker: Vince Goodwill
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James names OG Anunoby as Knicks' NBA Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: I think OG was the most steady person for that team.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Goodwill
text_blocks.text: LeBron stirring the pot, y'all. I like it. Bobby Marks, do you agree with LeBron?

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: For using football terminology this morning, I thought Jalen Brunson was the quarterback of that team. He still averaged 33 points in the NBA Finals and yes, he did not shoot the ball well. OG's block in that one game won them the game. But I would tend to agree with LeBron as far as the snake of that team. I thought it was Jalen Brunson as the quarterback here.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on LeBron James's focus on the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: LeBron seems to be talking about the Knicks at least as much as he's talking about the Sixers.
quotes.quote: I'm going to give him the benefit of the doubt. The man's a podcaster and it's been a long time since games have been played. You've got to work hard to fill a full off-season of content and LeBron's working hard to fill a full off-season of content. LeBron seems to be talking about the Knicks at least as much as he's talking about the Sixers. It is his hometown team now, but I'm going to give him the benefit of the doubt and say he's just talking basketball.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat's next major roster move likely coming next off-season
quotes.excerpt: I don't think that move is going to happen until probably this next summer here.
quotes.quote: I don't think that move is going to happen until probably this next summer here. When they traded for him, it's similar to when Miami went out and resigned Dwyane and Bosh. It was a multi-year phase. I think Giannis will extend with them for another four years, that gives them the ability to add more pieces to this roster. The question is how do you go out and do that? Most of your draft picks have already been traded out to Milwaukee. You do have some smaller pieces to do it, but I'm putting them in that tier three of teams from a contending standpoint. I think their next big move is probably going to be next off-season.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon evaluates Giannis Antetokounmpo as an MVP candidate
quotes.excerpt: There are five guys I think who are legit MVP candidates and he is absolutely on that list.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to sleep on him as an MVP candidate. There are five guys I think who are legit MVP candidates and he is absolutely on that list. If the Heat win 50-some odd games and he's healthy, which if they win 50-some odd games that means he's been healthy, then he's going to have a chance. I wouldn't put him first, second, or third on the preseason favorites, but he's on the short list.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' closing lineup potential with Victor Wembanyama and Dylan Harper
quotes.excerpt: I don't know about their best starting lineup, but I think it might be their best closing lineup.
quotes.quote: I don't know about their best starting lineup, but I think it might be their best closing lineup. Matchups are going to be somewhat of an issue if some teams go big. As long as Victor and Dylan Harper are on the floor to close games, I think this team will have a chance every night. It's a good problem to have. We haven't even seen Tobias Harris, who's been out with an injury. Dylan Harper as the closer, keep him in the game at the end of the games, that's what I'm probably going to be looking forward towards the most.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on the Spurs' need to start Dylan Harper
quotes.excerpt: The biggest challenge is three letters, EGO. And let's just be honest, that's why they absolutely have to start Dylan Harper now.
quotes.quote: We can talk about basketball issues, we can talk about maybe not enough shooting, things that they'll have to figure out, but the biggest challenge is three letters, EGO. And let's just be honest, that's why they absolutely have to start Dylan Harper now because he's too good, too confident, too ambitious to be coming off the bench in a second season. In his mind, he sacrificed to do that. It was interesting, Miss Johnson did just blurt out it wasn't a good enough shape to play more than 20 minutes last year without coughing up a lung. That raised my eyebrows, but I just think you've got a lot of guys here who want the ball in their hands, thrive with the ball in their hands, and so they're just going to have to figure out how to share and how not to let pride get in the way of the greater good.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on Cooper Flagg's rapid development
quotes.excerpt: This kid is a consistent jump shot away from being one of the most complete stars in the league.
quotes.quote: This is going to be a rapid ascension to superstar-dom, probably as soon as this season. He's bigger, he's stronger, he's more confident, he's more vocal, his skills are improving. This kid is a consistent jump shot away from being one of the most complete stars in the league right now.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg's potential to crack the top 20 NBA players
quotes.excerpt: He's on the cusp of cracking that top 20.
quotes.quote: He's right on the cusp. I think we had him at 23 in that ESPN top 100. The question is who kind of bumps out of that 10 to 20 range when you're looking at Kevin Durant and LeBron James. Man, he's coming. I think a lot of it will have to do with getting Kyrie Irving back, it's a big help to this roster. They've got a rookie coach in Dusty May, but he's on the cusp of cracking that top 20.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Tim MacMahon on Kyrie Irving's impact on Cooper Flagg
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie's return doesn't mean that Cooper's going to have the ball in his hands less often.
quotes.quote: There's a couple of things here. One, how long is Kyrie in Dallas? That's the question rival front offices are asking because there's a lot of interest in him. But as far as right now, he's a great complement for Cooper Flagg. Kyrie is obviously accustomed to playing off of the superstars. He can create, he can create advantages for Cooper, he can play off the ball. Dusty May made it clear, Kyrie's return doesn't mean that Cooper's going to have the ball in his hands less often, but he will have less pressure on him. He will be in better situations. And I got to tell you, it's one game, half a globe away, but Kyrie looked like Kyrie. He looked like an eight-time All-Star right away.
